Appearance of separate scenario recordings

Play recordings by scenario type or original episode

When a held piece slips or drops

A slip begins when the piece shifts within the grasp. A drop happens once hand support is lost and the piece falls. The slip recording schedules a grip shift before the fall. The drop recording schedules a direct release. The fingers partly obscure the piece during both grip changes in the head-camera view. Both recordings show the piece land on the table. Neither records a caught slip.

Compare the same piece (p020) in set 1211-2. The distinguishing motion is brief. The first link for each recording seeks to the grip change, and the second seeks to the fall.

  • Slip · Grip shift, frames 24–25 (2.00 s) · Fall, frames 26–29 (2.17 s)
  • Drop · Fingers open, frames 24–25 (2.00 s) · Fall, frames 26–29 (2.17 s)

Measurements from the current recordings

In each fixed cohort of 22 matched native recordings, 18 exceeded the stored skin-penetration limit and four were within it. Assessed active contact had 18 pad-gap exceedances and four films without values. Each contact-mode capture failed the reviewer’s strict-invocation check despite a complete video.

The 10348 evaluated mesh reaches 17.1 mm of inter-hand penetration at frame 885 and 47.0 mm below the tabletop under the left hand at frame 898. The images show overlapping hands and a flattened pose. The depth of a hidden surface is a geometry measurement. Exact forces and downstream guidance accuracy were not measured.

Fixed sample for this edition: 22 matched movies and 5,098 source frames.

10348-1 · manual_prefix_05 · Exact input · Producer · Encoder · Recording details

88.50 s The hands overlap. A dark patch appears and clears.

89.70 s The left hand looks flat against the table and then lifts.

101.20 s The fingers largely obscure the joint.

Automated diagnostics and distinct direct camera inspection · Fixed paired 22-movie diagnostic cohort · v10-2026-11-19 original evaluator readings by input and movie · Direct viewing against actual evaluated mesh extrema · v10-2026-11-19 source geometry probe · v10-2026-11-19 separately decoded source frames

Observations and measurements from the signed v8-2026-11-18 visual review. Open observations for v10-2026-11-19.

Gap and scene penetration use full-weight contacts; overlap and wrist displacement use all labeled frames. These sampled geometric measurements do not establish forces, continuous feasibility or visual realism. Reported infeasibility combines contact, proxy and kinematic findings.

The hand-contact reviewer also requires a strict invocation and transition evidence. Its internal render_completion check therefore fails for the current contacts/visual mode even when all images and video frames are complete. Missing strict evidence and measured geometric violations remain recorded; the separate rendering and decode results establish media completion.

The egocentric camera is attached to the animated head at the fitted eye midpoint. Device-specific AR-camera calibration is not established; the audit verifies the requested mount and retains the actual camera metadata.
